export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/havells-india-limited): "Total Shipments 65838 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; row: "2026-02-28 | HAVELLS INDIA LIMITED | RAGHANI TRADING L.L.C | SWITCHGEAR PRODUCT : DODIN100 D.B EXP SPN 2+10W DD REO W ISO/MCB 240V- | DADRI ICD INDER6, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 85371090 | BOL 1122543"; second row same date: "... | KELANI CABLES PLC | CAT 6 COMPUTER CABLE ... | ALBRATOS CFS PVT LTD ICD INAPL6, India | Colombo, Sri Lanka | 85444920 | BOL 1142014". Older US-side records on the 'havells-india-ltd' slug: "2022-06-13 | HAVELLS INDIA LTD. | AL ZUBAIR GENERAL TRADING EST. | SWITCHGEAR & CONTROLGEAR PRODUCTS | Mundra, India | Jebel Ali, UAE | 730024 | DEL30389B300". Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 65,838 shipments / 436 trading partners / 192 ports; only 5 dated export rows were visible on the free view (plus 5 rows on the second slug) — the counter is a platform aggregate, not independently verified.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in (https://www.screener.in/company/HAVELLS/consolidated/): "Havells India Ltd ... BSE: 517354 NSE: HAVELLS ... Market Cap ₹ 74,122 Cr." and quarterly consolidated sales "Sep 2026 ... 6,432" (Rs Cr), i.e. large recurring domestic turnover; segment split given as "Cables (~39% in FY26 ...) ... Lloyd Consumer (~18%) ... Electrical Consumer Durables (~17%) ... Switchgears (~12%) ... Lighting & Fixtures (~7%)". Note: Screener shows consolidated sales, not a separate India-only GST split; no GeM/CPPP contract record was retrieved (search tool returned no results).
note: Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE 517354 / NSE HAVELLS), so no rejection ground. Export shipments are factual, not merely declared: dated India-customs export rows with destination, HS and B/L numbers (e.g. 2026-02-28, Jebel Ali UAE, HS 85371090, B/L 1122543; Colombo Sri Lanka, HS 85444920, B/L 1142014). Declared HS codes in the batch (841381; 850910; 851610; 852990) do not match the observed export lines (85371090 switchgear/DB, 85444920 LAN cable, 85012000 motor, 730024 switchgear) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; actual codes should be corrected to the observed ones. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is wrong: company is FMEG/electricals (cables & wires, switchgear, lighting, fans, appliances). Revenue: consolidated quarterly sales Rs 6,432 Cr (Sep 2026 quarter, Screener); exact export share of revenue is not public in the sources read — null. Domestic supply confirmed by large GST-visible turnover and 17 manufacturing sites, but no single GeM/CPPP tender record was captured, so domestic evidence rests on financial disclosures rather than a contract record.
